description: This PHP source file defines the PartialClaimAttachment class within the OrangeHRM Claim Dto namespace. It models attachments related to claim requests, including properties such as attachment ID, file details, description, and associated employee information. The class includes methods for accessing and modifying these properties, along with traits for common functionalities.

classes.name: PartialClaimAttachment
classes.description: Represents an attachment to a claim request with properties like attachment ID, filename, size, description, file type, added by employee, and attached date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PartialClaimAttachment object with provided property values, including setting the addedByEmployee reference.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID associated with this attachment.

methods.name: getAttachId
methods.description: Returns the attachment ID.

methods.name: setAttachId
methods.description: Sets the attachment ID.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the attached date as a string formatted date.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the attached date using a DateTime object.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the associated ClaimRequest object.

methods.name: getAddedBy
methods.description: Returns the employee ID of the user who added the attachment.

methods.name: setAddedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee ID of the user who added the attachment.

methods.name: getAddedByEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object for the user who added the attachment.

methods.name: setAddedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object for the user who added the attachment.
